summary: DEFSEC Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of a registered direct offering of 673,006 common shares at CAD$3.74 (US$2.63) per share, raising CAD$2.5 million gross proceeds. Concurrently, unregistered warrants to purchase up to 673,006 shares at CAD$4.39 per share were issued in a private placement. H.C. Wainwright acted as exclusive placement agent, receiving a cash fee of CAD$188,778 and 50,475 warrants at CAD$4.675. Net proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation.
